articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.snippet: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: President Trump declares 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
articles.snippet: "Ukraine supports the ceasefire, and it is important that Russia support it as well," said Ukrainian President Zelensky.

articles.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
articles.snippet: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.

articles.title: Standard Chartered adds Ripple USD custody, eyes LMAX collateral deal
articles.snippet: Standard Chartered has launched custody for Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to let institutions use the tokens as trading collateral.

articles.title: NEXTPredict Paid $12,000 to Hedge Its Conference on a Prediction Market
articles.snippet: Where event insurance deals with scrapped shows and what happens inside the venue, NEXTPredict is focusing on flight cancellations.
